development_status.summary: Local-first Go CLI and tmux sidecar for long-running AI coding sessions. It records turns, entries, decisions, evidence, blockers, handoffs, attention items, share packets, report metrics, and agent attribution into repo-local SQLite while mirroring a readable markdown worklog.
recent_changes: Added attention command and report-view attention surfacing for stale blockers, evidence gaps, drift, long turns, and agent attribution warnings.
Added share command for portable Markdown or JSON team status packets.
Made handoff a first-class continuation artifact for compaction, restart, agent switching, and reviewer context.
Added storage and redaction policy as the gate for future hook/event ingest.
Added the first lane/team tracking slice with --lane, lane-specific active turn pointers, and parent_turn_id.
Clarified product boundary around a local-first terminal sidecar instead of a cloud dashboard, raw transcript archive, or agent runner.
active_work: Use the storage/redaction policy as the prerequisite for any future automated hook/event ingest.
Harden lane/team tracking in report, handoff, share, and future ingest surfaces.
Preserve local-only operation and Korean-first pane output while adding more structured machine-readable surfaces.
next_priorities: Add bounded ingest command for redacted hook events and reviewable evidence/blocker candidates.
Add hook starter kits only after redaction and retention rules are documented.
Add evidence-check or evidence-report wrappers over Phase E evidence workflows.

verification_commands.artifact_generation: dist/flightlog attention --format json && dist/flightlog share --format json --window week && dist/flightlog handoff --format json

Ingest share JSON as a session-status evidence artifact.
Ingest handoff JSON as a continuation and context-survival artifact.
Use report JSON metrics for closed-network operational health summaries.

reusable_patterns.name: turn-bounded task lifecycle
reusable_patterns.description: A turn captures intent, constraints, done-when, entries, outcome, evidence, blockers, and elapsed time as the primary work unit.
reusable_patterns.why_it_may_help_other_tools: Gives agents and operators a compact unit of accountability without storing full raw transcripts.

reusable_patterns.name: attention queue from local operational signals
reusable_patterns.description: Derived attention items convert blockers, evidence gaps, drift, long turns, and attribution warnings into operator actions.
reusable_patterns.why_it_may_help_other_tools: Turns passive metrics into reviewable next actions suitable for closed-network operation.

reusable_patterns.name: handoff as a first-class artifact
reusable_patterns.description: Handoff output summarizes current status, active turn anchors, open blockers, evidence gaps, latest evidence, and recommended next action.
reusable_patterns.why_it_may_help_other_tools: Improves context survival across compaction, restarts, and agent switching.

reusable_patterns.name: portable share packet
reusable_patterns.description: Share output exports completed turns, active blockers, decisions, evidence counts, metric highlights, and requested review/help.
reusable_patterns.why_it_may_help_other_tools: Provides team-readable status without requiring a dashboard or cloud account.

known_risks: Hook/event ingest must follow docs/storage-redaction-policy.md and must not store unredacted payloads by default.
Lane/team tracking has a first slice, but richer agent comparison should wait for more lane-aware reporting and ingest coverage.
Pane-visible text is optimized for Korean terminal operation and should not be treated as a stable machine contract.
Generated runtime state can contain local project context and should remain gitignored.
requests_to_ai_tool_suite: Treat ntts-flightlog as an agent-operation evidence source, not as an evaluation judge.
Prefer attention, share, handoff, and report JSON over scraping markdown worklogs.
Do not ingest raw .ntts-flightlog runtime output without an explicit operator opt-in and redaction policy.
Keep adapter certification blocked on stable event schema if hook/event ingest becomes the target.
